style.styleTitle: Personalised Bow Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a classic festive touch to your tree with this Personalised Red Bow Bauble, a beautiful Christmas decoration that makes a thoughtful keepsake or seasonal gift. Featuring a traditional red bow design, this bauble brings timeless Christmas charm and elegance to any festive display. It can be personalised with a name on the front and up to four lines of text on the reverse, each line allowing up to 20 characters, giving you plenty of space to create a meaningful message or special memory. The bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree, although the ribbon colour may vary, and the style of bauble topper may also differ, ensuring each piece has its own unique finish. Perfect for Christmas gifting or personal decoration, this personalised bauble is a lovely way to celebrate the season year after year. Dimensions(mm): Height: 60 Width: 60 Depth: 60.
